name: @projectx-social/ui

scripts.build: echo "@projectx-social/ui is consumed as source; nothing to build"

devDependencyComment: react and react-dom are peers for consumers (^19) and pinned here as devDependencies at the version the application runs. Without the pin, pnpm auto-installs the peer for this package and is free to satisfy ^19 from whatever copy the lockfile already holds — it chose 19.2.8 while packages/web ran 19.3.0, which put TWO Reacts in one bundle. That is invisible until a component from here uses a hook: the second React's dispatcher is null and every render through it dies on `Cannot read properties of null (reading 'useRef')`. The pin is what keeps the workspace on one copy.
